input.query: SELECT month, reject_reason, n_rejections FROM agg_kyc_reject_reasons_monthly WHERE platform='ios' AND doc_type='driving_licence' AND month BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-01' AND DATE '2026-05-01' ORDER BY month, reject_reason

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', decision_date)::DATE AS week_start, SUM(n_decisions) AS decisions, SUM(n_approved) AS approved, SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_decisions) AS approval_rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE platform='ios' AND doc_type='driving_licence' AND decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-05-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
